prompt: Create a transparent 4-column × 2-row atlas for the TWO Ancient Tomb Masonry corners. Row1 INNER; row2 OUTER. Columns are FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR. Use the corresponding Ink source at far left of each corner guide sheet to control warm gold/engraved material and source block motif. Use the Pocket same-ID top/bottom images only to understand L footprint; the third reference sheet is approved same-kit NW wall and defines common vertical Z. CRITICAL: every one of these eight elevation faces is a broad RECTANGULAR WALL ARM exactly FOUR square blocks wide × THREE full courses tall, matching the NW reference wall's three-course Z. Include 12 square stone blocks per cell arranged 4 wide ×3 high, tightly joined, straight-on orthographic. Each of the four camera views shows one straight wall arm only; do not show any perpendicular return arm, no L-shaped elevations, no single post, no thin one-course strip, no perspective/foreshortening. All four faces same apparent height and comparable width. Warm orange-gold Ink stone with source-appropriate engraved motifs, never blue-gray. No extra towers, no banners, no objects. Each cell contains one complete centered rectangle with transparent gutters and no clipping. Inferred orthographic artwork, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

reference_inputs.role: canonical Ink corner sources and accepted same-kit NE wall material/common-Z guide
